data.en: My father's last visit was about twenty years ago.
data.cn: 我父亲上一次来访大约是二十年前。
data.hint: last visit 搭配过去式 was
accept: About twenty years ago was my father's last visit.

data.en: They have not seen each other for ages.
data.cn: 他们已经好多年没见过面了。
data.hint: 现在完成时否定句，for ages 意为“多年”
accept: For ages they have not seen each other.

data.en: When I first visited here, it took half a day to reach the town.
data.cn: 当我第一次来这里时，花了半天时间才到达镇上。
data.hint: when 引导的时间状语从句，it took + 时间
accept: It took half a day to reach the town when I first visited here.

data.en: With the new roads, it takes only an hour now.
data.cn: 有了新公路，现在只需一个小时。
data.hint: with 表示伴随条件，takes 表达一般现在时
accept: Now with the new roads it takes only an hour.

data.en: The bus took nearly forty minutes over rough roads to get to school.
data.cn: 在崎岖不平的道路上，乘公共汽车上学花了将近四十分钟。
data.hint: over rough roads 介词短语修饰路面状况
accept: To get to school, the bus took nearly forty minutes over rough roads.

data.en: We used to have to travel far to see a doctor.
data.cn: 我们过去常常得走很远的路去看医生。
data.hint: used to have to 表示“过去不得不”

data.en: Our town has built a new hospital near the centre.
data.cn: 我们镇在市中心附近建了一所新医院。
data.hint: 现在完成时 has built 表示已完成的建设
accept: Near the centre our town has built a new hospital.

data.en: We did not have any such places for shopping until ten years ago.
data.cn: 直到十年前，我们才有这样的购物场所。
data.hint: not... until... 直到……才……
accept: Until ten years ago we did not have any such places for shopping.

data.en: The hills used to be covered with sand.
data.cn: 那些山丘过去被沙子覆盖着。
data.hint: used to be covered with 表示过去的状态

data.en: Now they have been covered with beautiful trees.
data.cn: 现在它们已经被美丽的树木覆盖。
data.hint: 现在完成时的被动语态 have been covered with

data.en: There used to be sandstorms all the time.
data.cn: 过去常常有沙尘暴发生。
data.hint: there used to be 表示“过去常常有”
accept: All the time there used to be sandstorms.

data.en: The corn fields were getting smaller and smaller.
data.cn: 玉米田变得越来越小。
data.hint: were getting + 比较级 and 比较级

data.en: Locals found a small bush with long roots.
data.cn: 当地人发现了一种长着长根的小灌木。
data.hint: with long roots 介词短语作后置定语

data.en: The roots could hold the soil together firmly.
data.cn: 这些根能够把土壤牢牢地固定在一起。
data.hint: hold ... together 把……凝聚/固定在一起

data.en: They began planting it with the government's support.
data.cn: 他们在政府的支持下开始种植它。
data.hint: begin doing sth., with sb's support
accept: With the government's support, they began planting it.

data.en: In the beginning, we worked entirely by hand.
data.cn: 起初，我们完全靠手工劳作。
data.hint: in the beginning 起初；by hand 靠手工
accept: We worked entirely by hand in the beginning.

data.en: Later on, we had modern machines to help us.
data.cn: 后来，我们有了现代化的机器来帮助我们。
data.hint: to help us 动词不定式作目的状语
accept: We had modern machines to help us later on.

data.en: We have planted many bushes and trees since then.
data.cn: 从那时起，我们种植了许多灌木和树木。
data.hint: since then 与现在完成时 have planted 搭配
accept: Since then, we have planted many bushes and trees.

data.en: There are fewer sandstorms now and the environment is better.
data.cn: 现在的沙尘暴减少了，环境也变好了。
data.hint: fewer 修饰可数名词复数 sandstorms

data.en: These green changes have greatly improved our lives.
data.cn: 这些绿色的改变极大地改善了我们的生活。
data.hint: greatly 副词修饰动词 improved

data.en: Many young people used to work in big cities.
data.cn: 许多年轻人过去常常在大城市工作。
data.hint: used to work 表示过去的习惯

data.en: More young villagers have come back to live and work here.
data.cn: 更多的年轻村民已经回到这里生活和工作。
data.hint: have come back 现在完成时
accept: More young villagers have come back here to live and work.

data.en: I used to grow a few vegetables on a small farm.
data.cn: 我过去常常在小农场里种些蔬菜。
data.hint: grow vegetables 种蔬菜；on a small farm

data.en: Now I have large and high-tech greenhouses.
data.cn: 现在我拥有大型的高科技温室。
data.hint: high-tech 高科技的
accept: Now I have high-tech and large greenhouses.

data.en: I grow tons of fresh fruit and vegetables there.
data.cn: 我在那里种植了成吨的新鲜水果和蔬菜。
data.hint: tons of 成吨的 / 大量的

data.en: Our village has become a famous tourist attraction.
data.cn: 我们的村庄已经成为一个著名的旅游景点。
data.hint: tourist attraction 旅游景点

data.en: We can now sell local products to tourists directly.
data.cn: 我们现在可以直接向游客销售本地特产。
data.hint: sell sth. to sb. 把某物卖给某人
accept: We can directly sell local products to tourists now.

data.en: We also sell agricultural products online to customers.
data.cn: 我们还在网上向客户销售农产品。
data.hint: online 作副词修饰 sell

data.en: Our village has just built a new library for reading.
data.cn: 我们村刚刚建了一座供阅读的新图书馆。
data.hint: has just built 强调刚刚完成

data.en: Together you are building a prosperous new village.
data.cn: 你们齐心协力正在建设一个繁荣的新农村。
data.hint: together 放在句首作状语
accept: You are building a prosperous new village together.

challenges.title: On the Fast Track: Modern Transport

data.en: The Mombasa-Nairobi railway was opened in 2017.
data.cn: 蒙巴萨-内罗毕铁路于2017年开通。
data.hint: in 2017 搭配过去时的被动语态 was opened
accept: In 2017, the Mombasa-Nairobi railway was opened.

data.en: The old railway was completed more than a century ago.
data.cn: 这条旧铁路是在一个多世纪前建成的。
data.hint: was completed 被动语态；a century ago

data.en: The old trains were very slow and unreliable.
data.cn: 以前的火车非常慢且不可靠。
data.hint: were slow 描述过去的特征

data.en: It took ten hours to travel between the two cities.
data.cn: 在两座城市之间旅行需要耗费十个小时。
data.hint: it took + 时间 + to do sth.

data.en: The new railway has cut travel time to five hours.
data.cn: 新铁路已将旅行时间缩短至五个小时。
data.hint: cut travel time to 缩短时间至……

data.en: More than two million passengers use it every year.
data.cn: 每年有超过两百万名乘客使用它。
data.hint: more than 超过；every year 一般现在时
accept: Every year more than two million passengers use it.

data.en: I am able to get to places on time and do business with ease.
data.cn: 我能够准时到达各地并轻松开展业务。
data.hint: be able to 能够；with ease 轻松地

data.en: The railway has also made food transport much easier.
data.cn: 铁路也使食品运输变得容易得多。
data.hint: make sth. + 比较级 easier

data.en: As a result, local people now have more fresh food to eat.
data.cn: 结果，当地人现在有了更多新鲜的食物吃。
data.hint: as a result 作为结果 / 因此
accept: Local people now have more fresh food to eat as a result.

data.en: Different countries can work together to build a better world.
data.cn: 不同的国家可以携手合作建设一个更美好的世界。
data.hint: work together to do sth. 合作做某事
accept: To build a better world, different countries can work together.

data.en: Wang Shanghai moved to the sandy lands of Saihanba in 1962.
data.cn: 王尚海于1962年搬到了塞罕坝的沙地上。
data.hint: moved to 迁至；in 1962 过去时间
accept: In 1962 Wang Shanghai moved to the sandy lands of Saihanba.

data.en: There were few trees to hold the loose soil together.
data.cn: 几乎没有树木来把松散的土壤固定在一起。
data.hint: few 表示几乎没有，修饰可数名词

data.en: Over the next sixty years, workers planted millions of trees.
data.cn: 在接下来的六十年里，工人们种植了数百万棵树。
data.hint: over the next sixty years 在接下来的60年中
accept: Workers planted millions of trees over the next sixty years.

data.en: Today Saihanba is widely known as the green miracle.
data.cn: 如今，塞罕坝被广泛誉为“绿色奇迹”。
data.hint: be widely known as 被公认为
accept: Saihanba is widely known as the green miracle today.

data.en: This great achievement is the result of persistent hard work.
data.cn: 这项伟大的成就离不开坚持不懈的努力。
data.hint: the result of ...的结果

data.en: Now that I am older, my life is quite different.
data.cn: 既然我长大了，我的生活就大不相同了。
data.hint: now that 既然；be different from
accept: My life is quite different now that I am older.

data.en: I take a bus every single day with my close friends.
data.cn: 我每天都和我的挚友一起乘坐公共汽车。
data.hint: take a bus 乘公交
accept: With my close friends, I take a bus every single day.

data.en: I have become more confident in my academic studies.
data.cn: 在学业上，我变得更加自信了。
data.hint: have become 现在完成时；confident 自信的

data.en: It is amazing how much progress we have achieved together.
data.cn: 我们在共同努力下取得的巨大进步令人惊叹。
data.hint: it is amazing how much ... 令人惊异的是……

data.en: The deep love and happiness in my family remain unchanged.
data.cn: 我家庭中深沉的爱与幸福始终未变。
data.hint: remain unchanged 保持不变
